scope: paired retrospective price-only versus night-augmented research
night_return_definition: 10000*(night last trade / same-contract previous regular-session last trade - 1)
contract_rule: Earliest YYYYMM month with a positive traded completed night quote available before cutoff; reject if its own previous day close is missing; never use current day volume or another contracts close
night_exchange_date_rule: Official TAIFEX night row belongs to the following regular session; start at previous observed regular-session date 15:00, end next calendar day 05:00. Preserve weekend/holiday age.
reference_price_features: For TX, prior-day and prior-prior-day prices all belong to the currently selected contract; no cross-contract price changes
update_rule: Daily expanding fit on strictly earlier common matched rows for all arms; no refit selection from evaluation results
wick_rule: Same expanding mean of past nonnegative log-wicks in all arms
primary_metric: open MAE in bps; predeclared useful improvement >=5% and paired time-block interval lower bound >0
secondary_metric: close MAE >=5% improvement and no O/H/L MAE deterioration >5% for original price gate
availability_assumption: Completed historical night last trade is assumed usable by 08:30 for retrospective simulation; fetched_at is not substituted for historical available_at.
limitations: Night bulk-CSV historical publication time is unverified
Evaluation TAIEX price labels have already been used in earlier research
TX is a deterministic sequence of selected monthly contracts, not the old single far-month TX202603 experiment
Session times follow standard exchange rules; exceptional schedule changes require separate verification
No probabilities, calibrated intervals or trading profitability claim
